verdict.rationale: Mistral's core interface is a conversational API/chat surface (agents, function calling, reasoning, RAG, code interpreter, websearch) all driven by natural-language prompts, and community reports confirm real users interacting with it via natural-language queries and getting reasonable/fast responses. Missing for 10: no evidence of natural-language control over non-conversational product operations (e.g., billing/admin, deployment config) and no independent benchmark specifically on instruction-following fidelity across the product's surfaces.
